verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack states that Unstructured does not train on customer data or offers a training opt-out. The closest support is indirect: the business tier deploys in a dedicated instance or your own VPC with "full data isolation" for teams needing privacy, and the product claims SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR conformance. These suggest data stays under customer control, but only on an enterprise-tier deployment and only by implication. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-usage policy, a training opt-out available on standard/free tiers, data retention terms, and independent corroboration.
